# Turn a KDP royalty report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Turn a KDP royalty report into month-split journal entries by marketplace and format, with printing cost and tax withheld booked. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages
